title: Standard WOFOST daily forcing and accepted-process aggregate contract

examples: partitioning, conversion, respiration, SLA and senescence tables
immutable_crop_parameters.rule: shared/referenceable parameter data; never rewritten as daily forcing or dynamic crop state

persistent_crop_state.rule: not repeated inside the forcing DTO

daily_weather_or_derived_event_forcing.name: TMN
daily_weather_or_derived_event_forcing.meaning: minimum air temperature for the crop window
daily_weather_or_derived_event_forcing.legacy_use: inserted once into atmin7 at day-start assimilation

daily_weather_or_derived_event_forcing.name: TAV
daily_weather_or_derived_event_forcing.legacy_use: phenology, maintenance respiration and physiological leaf ageing

daily_weather_or_derived_event_forcing.name: solar_geometry
daily_weather_or_derived_event_forcing.meaning: explicit astronomical forcing for the crop window
daily_weather_or_derived_event_forcing.target_rule: calendar/day-of-year translation is outside the crop kernel; no hidden daynr/t1900/calendar global is admitted

daily_weather_or_derived_event_forcing.name: FCO2EFF/FCO2AMAX
daily_weather_or_derived_event_forcing.meaning: CO2 response factors where the selected crop physics uses them
daily_weather_or_derived_event_forcing.classification: event-derived forcing/process input, not persistent crop state

accepted_process_aggregates.name: IQROT_WINDOW
accepted_process_aggregates.meaning: actual root water uptake integrated over accepted soil-water substeps in the crop window
accepted_process_aggregates.units: cm water over the one-day crop window
accepted_process_aggregates.target_owner: runtime/F-KT accepted-step accounting; F-MR09 already establishes authoritative exactly-once root-extraction mass ownership
accepted_process_aggregates.acceptance_rule: only accepted substep results may be accumulated; rejected trial fluxes contribute exactly zero

accepted_process_aggregates.name: IPTRA_WINDOW
accepted_process_aggregates.meaning: potential transpiration rate integrated over accepted substep durations in the crop window
accepted_process_aggregates.units: cm water over the one-day crop window
accepted_process_aggregates.target_producer_note: F-WOF18 qualifies a restricted potential-transpiration rate producer but does not itself integrate or persist IPTRA_WINDOW
accepted_process_aggregates.acceptance_rule: integrate the process rate only for the final accepted duration of each substep; no rejected duration is booked

accepted_process_aggregates.name: IALPWET_WINDOW
accepted_process_aggregates.meaning: time integral over the accepted crop window of the dimensionless oxygen/aeration factor at the bottom of the root zone
accepted_process_aggregates.legacy_comment_units: dimensionless because the legacy window is exactly one day
accepted_process_aggregates.temporal_semantic: for a one-day window the integral is numerically the daily mean and is compared directly with dimensionless AERATECRIT; that comparison is not automatically equivalent for an arbitrary-duration crop window
consumers: standard WOFOST SWRD=3 root-growth suppression when the corresponding oxygen/root-aeration option is active
root-extension suppression in cropdevelopment when the corresponding physics is active
accepted_process_aggregates.target_owner: accepted root-uptake/oxygen-process aggregation outside persistent crop state
accepted_process_aggregates.acceptance_rule: only accepted interval results may be accumulated; rejected oxygen/root-uptake trials contribute exactly zero

examples: DAYLP if solar_geometry is not passed pre-expanded
event_local_rates_and_intermediates.storage_rule: temporary crop-window context or worker/batch scratch only

legacy_acceptance_provenance.retry_loop: SWAP/swap.f90:433-457 runs SoilWater trials/reductions until the timestep is no longer reduced
legacy_acceptance_provenance.accepted_state_update: SWAP/swap.f90:459-460 calls SoilWater(3) only after the retry loop exits
legacy_acceptance_provenance.aggregate_booking: SWAP/swap.f90:462-463 calls integral(3) after that accepted-step update
legacy_acceptance_provenance.result: legacy day totals do not book a separate contribution for rejected SoilWater retries
legacy_acceptance_provenance.target_strengthening: modern accumulation must be tied explicitly to F-KT/F-MR accepted-result lineage and exactly-once booking rather than inferred from call order

crop_window_aggregate_contract.initial_admission: t1-t0 is exactly one qualified crop day
crop_window_aggregate_contract.reset: new aggregate carrier starts at zero at t0; reset is a runtime window operation, not a global calendar-day side effect
crop_window_aggregate_contract.accumulate: append exactly-once accepted process contributions whose accepted interval lies inside the crop window
crop_window_aggregate_contract.finalize: freeze the aggregate carrier before crop finalization; later trial work cannot mutate the frozen accepted view
crop_window_aggregate_contract.lineage: all contributions must belong to the same parent physical candidate lineage and crop-window identity

day_start_assimilation_dependency.finding: legacy assimilation is executed before the day's soil-water substeps, not at day end
optional_same_window_soil_process_output: f_senes when oxygen physics is active
day_start_assimilation_dependency.implication: the safe one-day event cannot be modeled as a day-end-only black box if oxygen/root-respiration physics consumes these day-start outputs during soil-water substeps
day_start_assimilation_dependency.target_rule: prepare a trial-local crop-window context from the committed crop checkpoint at t0, expose only read-only same-window process inputs, accumulate accepted soil/process results, then finalize one candidate crop state at t1. None of the day-start candidate climate-memory updates are committed before the parent transaction commits.
